title: Orvan Grain Port holds ships as strike enters first week

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Orvan Grain Port is holding vessels outside the harbour as a dock strike that began on 14 September continues.

source_ref.text_snippet: Orvan Grain Port is holding vessels outside the harbour as a dock strike that began on 14 September continues.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Several bulk carriers are waiting in the roads, according to port agents.

source_ref.text_snippet: Several bulk carriers are waiting in the roads, according to port agents.

facts.subject: Hammer Freight
facts.statement: Hammer Freight, a bulk operator, says it has moved ships to Vanir for wheat cargoes.

source_ref.text_snippet: Hammer Freight, a bulk operator, says it has moved ships to Vanir for wheat cargoes.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: The port authority says it cannot estimate when normal working will resume.

source_ref.text_snippet: The port authority says it cannot estimate when normal working will resume.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: The queue outside the harbour is being managed by the port authority, which is giving priority to vessels that were already on the berth list when the strike began.

source_ref.text_snippet: The queue outside the harbour is being managed by the port authority, which is giving priority to vessels that were already on the berth list when the strike began.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Some buyers have begun to ask for rail alternatives.

source_ref.text_snippet: Some buyers have begun to ask for rail alternatives.

facts.subject: Buyers in Midgard and Tolan
facts.statement: Buyers in Midgard and Tolan have been told to expect longer delays.

source_ref.text_snippet: Buyers in Midgard and Tolan have been told to expect longer delays.
